caseName: Illinois Commerce Commission v. Illinois Central Railroad
caseNameFull: Illinois Commerce Commission v. Illinois Central Railroad Co.
attorneys: George F. Barrett, Attorney General, and William C. Wines, Assistant Attorney General, for appellants., Messrs. Vernon W. Foster, Charles A. Helsell and Elmer A. Smith for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The appeal is dismissed for want of jurisdiction. § 237 (a), Judicial Code, as amended, 28 U. S. C. § 344 (a). Treating the papers whereon the appeal was allowed as a petition for writ of certiorari as required by § 237 (c) of the Judicial Code, as amended, 28 U. S. C. § 344'(c), certiorari is denied.
